query:
SELECT id, nameAr, nameEn, parentId
FROM product_categories
WHERE nameAr IN (
  SELECT nameAr FROM product_categories
  GROUP BY nameAr
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
ORDER BY nameAr, id;
